newsitem.title: USA: Manor Care stake raised by Ronald Baron.
newsitem.headline: Manor Care stake raised by Ronald Baron.

text.p: New York investor Ronald Baron said Tuesday he raised his stake in Manor Care Inc to 9.2 percent, or 5,777,784 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Baron said he bought, through firms he controls, 571,500 additional shares of Manor Care between November 6 and January 6 at prices ranging from $24.0938 to $27.5619 a share.
Baron, who previously held an 8.1 percent stake in Manor Care, is president of Baron Capital Management Inc, a New York-based investment firm.
Manor Care, based in Gaithersburg, Md., owns and operates nursing centers.
